overall_goal: Weigh ingredients, log their weights, and clean up the workspace

goals.description: Measure, arrange, and log the weight of the fennel seeds
goals.rationale: The person pours fennel seeds onto a plate, logs their weight in a notebook, and arranges them neatly on the weighing scale.

goals.description: Seal the spice bags with rubber bands
goals.rationale: The person uses rubber bands to tightly close the bags of fennel seeds and garam masala powder.

goals.description: Weigh the onion and log its weight
goals.rationale: The person places an onion on the weighing scale, turns the scale on, and records the measured weight in a notebook before returning the onion to the chopping board.

goals.description: Weigh the green chillies and log their weight
goals.rationale: The person places green chillies on the weighing scale, writes down their weight in the notebook, and moves them back to the chopping board.

goals.description: Transfer cut ginger and dispose of ginger peels
goals.rationale: The person scrapes cut ginger onto the wooden chopping board and throws the peeled ginger skin into the rubbish bin.

goals.description: Clean hands to remove ingredient residues
goals.rationale: The person rubs their hands to remove chilli seeds and garlic skin, then washes and dries their hands at the sink.
